areas.name: Campaign, Medals, and Endings
areas.location_cue: Main markers, camp transitions, the Story replay menu, and the final two-choice prompt.
areas.note: Ending labels expose only honor state and response position; no narrative result is named.

items.label: Complete the full story and free-roam epilogue

levels.1: Follow main markers, but clear white markers and camp opportunities before every relocation.
levels.2: Finish every available main and optional story objective through the permanent free-roam state.
levels.3: Complete the full campaign, including optional honor-marked objectives, then use Progress > Story to replay any missed medal objective. Preserve the chapter-window backups until all camp records are confirmed.

items.label: Earn every story mission gold medal

levels.1: Attempt visible medal conditions during the first run, then use replay for cleanup.
levels.2: Open Progress > Story and inspect every completed mission's medal checklist.
levels.3: Replay each mission and satisfy all displayed gold conditions in the same attempt where the checklist requires it. Continue until every mission tile shows gold; the lower official threshold is not the goal of this guide.

levels.1: Return to camp often during the manor-camp window.
levels.2: Accept the exclusive bank activity from its camp companion during the manor-camp period.
levels.3: Complete the Special/Ultimate Edition bank activity before the camp relocates; it cannot be started from post-campaign free roam.

levels.1: Check the bonus stronghold after its surrounding region becomes freely explorable.
levels.2: Clear the exclusive Del Lobos hideout included with the chosen edition.
levels.3: Enter the bonus stronghold, defeat all waves, loot its reward spaces, and wait for the hideout-cleared notification.

levels.1: Revisit gunsmiths, stables, fences, and general stores after progression updates.

levels.3: Use each regional catalogue, buy all non-consumable entries, read every recipe pamphlet, stable every unique breed/coat needed for the archive, and confirm all permanent equipment appears in its destination menu.

items.label: Resolve every documented world secret and Easter egg

levels.3: Follow each clue chain to its final inspectable state, collect any unique document or object, and record menu confirmation where one exists. Purely repeatable ambience needs only one completed viewing.
